Lesson 11.1 · 40 of 78 · 22 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Facilities, limits and drawdowns

After this lesson you can:
  • Distinguish term, demand and revolving facilities
  • Explain limit, drawing power and availability
  • Model drawdown, renewal and expiry

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. Facility is the legal container
  2. Availability is calculated
  3. Lifecycle vocabulary
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. Facility is the legal container

A term loan disburses an amount against a schedule.

A revolving facility allows repeated draw and repayment within an approved limit.

Cash credit and overdraft additionally depend on drawing power, review and account-operation rules.

A demand facility has no ordinary amortising promise and can become payable on demand.

The account is an operational representation of the facility; one facility can have tranches, drawdowns or participant shares.

2. Availability is calculated

Sanctioned limit is not always drawable limit.

Conditions precedent, margin, borrowing-base eligibility, expired stock statements, covenant breaches, utilisation and pending settlements can reduce availability.

The BA specifies each component, refresh event and fail-closed outcome.

3. Lifecycle vocabulary

Origination creates and approves the facility; utilisation draws it; servicing accrues and collects; review renews, reduces or exits it.

Expiry stops new drawdowns but does not erase outstanding exposure.

Cancellation, closure and write-off are different states with different money and evidence consequences.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-KFS-2024 — Facility economics and repayment obligations must resolve into borrower disclosure.
  • RBI-IT-GRC — Facility state and availability require controlled, traceable processing.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability PRD-001 — Facility family definition.
  • Capability LMS-004 — Bullet, balloon and structured schedules.
  • Capability LMS-015 — Limit and drawdown structures.

Retrieval practice

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. A cash-credit limit is ₹1 crore but drawing power is ₹70 lakh. What is ordinarily available before other blocks?

  1. ₹1 crore
  2. ₹70 lakh
  3. The outstanding balance
  4. Zero
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Availability is constrained by drawing power even when sanction is higher.
